record.question: According to Article 343(i) of the Constitution, what is the official language of the Union of India?
options: All the languages in the Eighth Schedule
record.explanation: Answer B: Hindi in Devanagari script. Article 343 names Hindi in Devanagari script as the Union’s official language, subject to continued statutory use of English. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
